title: What is React and why is it used?
content: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. It helps create fast, scalable, and reusable UI components using a virtual DOM.

title: What are React Hooks?
content: Hooks are functions like useState, useEffect, and useContext that allow you to use React features without writing class components.

title: What is the Virtual DOM in React?
content: The Virtual DOM is a lightweight copy of the real DOM. React uses it to update only the necessary parts of the UI, improving performance.

title: What is the difference between state and props?
content: Props are read-only inputs passed to components, while state is internal data managed inside a component and can change over time.

title: What is JSX in React?
content: JSX is a syntax extension that allows writing HTML-like code inside JavaScript. It makes UI code more readable and easier to maintain.
